detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Epithalon (Epitalon) (Encapsulated Solid)

Chemical Information:

  • Peptide Name: Epithalon (Epitalon)
  • Molecular Formula: C₁₄H₂₂N₄O₉
  • Molecular Weight: 390.35 g/mol
  • Sequence: Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly
  • Compound Class: Synthetic tetrapeptide

Molecular Structure:

 

Product Description:

Epithalon (Epitalon) is a synthetic tetrapeptide composed of a defined amino acid sequence produced through controlled peptide synthesis. The material is provided in an encapsulated solid format, intended solely as a physical containment and presentation method to facilitate controlled storage, handling, and measurement in research settings. The encapsulated format does not imply any route of administration. Epithalon is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals for analytical and experimental evaluation under controlled, non-clinical conditions.

Research Applications:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of peptide stability and degradation profiles under defined conditions
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and in vitro assay systems
  • Characterization of peptide interactions within controlled experimental models

Storage and Handling:

  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from direct light
  • Maintain container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety and aseptic techniques

Product Specifications:

  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
  • Format: Encapsulated solid research peptide
  • Per-Capsule Content: Epithalon (Epitalon) — 500mcg and 1000 mcg
  • Appearance: White to off-white solid
  • Solubility: Soluble in aqueous laboratory media following capsule removal for analytical use

Compliance Notice:

Epithalon (Epitalon) (Encapsulated Solid) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
